name: folder-open
description: An open folder with an uncluttered front flap.
useCase: Show an expanded directory with its named control.
misuse: Expose aria-expanded on the actual control.

16.reason: The open flap extends right to counter the tab; the two contours meet at endpoints rather than painting a doubled bottom edge. Text master: 1.5px construction. The complete silhouette is centered within the shared 12 × 12 drawing area.

24.reason: The open flap extends right to counter the tab; the two contours meet at endpoints rather than painting a doubled bottom edge. Interface master: 1.75px construction. The complete silhouette is centered within the shared 18 × 18 drawing area.
